info.title: BeePost — Carrier API
info.description:
BeePost posilkalarini yetkazadigan tashqi kompaniya uchun API. Elchi Pochta Carrier API bilan **bir xil kontrakt**: yo'llar, maydonlar, javob shakllari va xato `code` lari bir xil — farq baza manzili, kalit va "BeePost profili" (`CARRIER_API.md`, Ilova A). BeePost'da siz **bitta kurier akkaunti** sifatida ishlaysiz: BeePost xodimi pochtani sizga jo'natadi, siz posilka QR'ini skanerlaysiz va yetkazish natijasini yuborasiz. Pul sizning kurier kassangizga yoziladi.

## Ish tartibi (qisqa)

1. `POST /carrier/scan` — posilka sizga o'tadi (`waiting`).
2. **`POST /carrier/orders/{id}/status`** — natija: `sold` / `partly_sold` / `cancelled` (xato bo'lsa — `rollback`).
3. `POST /carrier/returns` — bekor qilinganlarni qaytarish.
4. `GET /carrier/cashbox` — kassa va naqd topshirish.

## 1. Kirish

Baza manzili: `https://<beepost-domain>/api/v1` (aniq domenni BeePost operatori beradi). Har so'rovda `X-Api-Key` sarlavhasi (kalit `bpc_` bilan boshlanadi, uni BeePost operatori beradi). Kalit faqat bir marta ko'rsatiladi — xavfsiz saqlang.

Interaktiv hujjat: `https://<beepost-domain>/api/v1/carrier-docs` (login va parolni BeePost beradi). U yerda **Authorize** tugmasiga kalitni kiritib, so'rovlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sinash mumkin.

```bash
curl https://<beepost-domain>/api/v1/carrier/ping -H "X-Api-Key: bpc_..."
```

## 2. Ish oqimi

**1) Skanerlash** — posilkani qo'lingizga olganda:

```bash
curl -X POST https://<beepost-domain>/api/v1/carrier/scan \
  -H "X-Api-Key: bpc_..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"qr_token":"5f2a9c1e7b3d4a6f8e0c2b19"}'
```

Javobda buyurtma (`data.order`): mijoz, manzil, tovarlar va **`cod_amount` — mijozdan olinadigan naqd** (BeePost'da `= total_price`). Viloyat va tuman nomi emas, **SOATO kodi** bilan keladi: `region.soato_code` (4 xona), `district.soato_code` (7 xona; kod noma'lum bo'lsa `null`). Yo'ldagi (`on the road`) posilka shu skanda sizga qabul qilinadi (`status: waiting`). Sotish va bekor qilish faqat shundan keyin mumkin. `replacement.old_item_required: true` — almashtirish: eski mahsulotni oling va sotishda `old_item_collected: true` yuboring.

**2) Natijani yuborish** — `data.order.id` (UUID) bilan. **`Idempotency-Key` majburiy** — har yangi urinish uchun yangi UUID:

```bash
curl -X POST https://<beepost-domain>/api/v1/carrier/orders/3f6c1a2e-8b4d-4c7a-9e21-5d0b7f3a9c10/status \
  -H "X-Api-Key: bpc_..." -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"status":"sold"}'
```

| status | Qachon | Qo'shimcha maydonlar |
|---|---|---|
| `sold` | To'liq sotildi | — |
| `partly_sold` | Qisman sotildi | `total_price` (mijoz olgan tovarlar qiymati, butun so'm), `items: [{order_item_id, quantity}]` — buyurtmaning har bir qatori |
| `cancelled` | Mijoz olmadi | `reason`: `CUSTOMER_NO_ANSWER`, `CUSTOMER_REFUSED`, `WRONG_ADDRESS`, `DEFECTIVE_PRODUCT`, `PRICE_DISPUTE`, `OTHER` (+ `comment`) |
| `rollback` | Xato yuborilgan sold/cancelled ni qaytarish | — (holat aynan sold yoki cancelled bo'lsa) |

**3) Bekor qilinganlarni qaytarish** — `cancelled` posilkalar (qisman sotuvning sotilmagan qismi ham) sizda qoladi: `POST /carrier/returns` `{"order_ids":["3f6c1a2e-8b4d-4c7a-9e21-5d0b7f3a9c10"]}` → qaytarish pochtasi (`post_id`); posilkalarni BeePost'ga topshirasiz. Qaytarilgan posilka `/carrier/orders` ro'yxatidan chiqadi.

**4) Solishtirish** — `GET /carrier/orders` (sizdagi buyurtmalar) va `GET /carrier/cashbox` (balans va oxirgi 30 kunlik harakatlar).

## 3. Muhim qoidalar

- Faqat **sizga biriktirilgan** buyurtmalar ko'rinadi; boshqasiga `404`. Barcha id'lar — UUID satr; UUID bo'lmagan id — `400`.
- `Idempotency-Key`: har **yangi** urinish — yangi kalit; javob kelmasa — **ayni kalit** bilan qayta yuboring (amal ikki marta bajarilmaydi). Rollback'dan keyingi qayta sotuv — yangi kalit (eskisi bilan `409 CARRIER_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_STALE`).
- Limit: akkaunt uchun daqiqada 120 so'rov, barcha endpoint birgalikda (`429`, `Retry-After`). Ro'yxatni bittalab emas, sahifalab oling.
- Xato javobi: `{ statusCode, message, code?, trace_id }` (`trace_id` `X-Trace-Id` sarlavhasida ham). Qarorni matnga emas, `statusCode`/`code` ga qarab qiling. `trace_id` ni saqlang — muammo bo'lsa BeePost'ga yuboring.
- `409`, `429`, `5xx`, `503`, `504` — biroz kutib, **ayni** `Idempotency-Key` bilan qayta urining (`CARRIER_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_STALE` — yangi kalit; 10 daqiqadan uzoq takrorlansa — BeePost'ga). Boshqa `4xx` — so'rovni tuzating.
- `refreshed: false` — holat qabul qilindi, buyurtmani keyinroq o'qing (qayta yubormang).

## 4. Pul

Sotuvda kassangizga **(mijozdan olingan naqd − yetkazish haqingiz)** yoziladi — bu BeePost'ga topshiriladigan summa. Naqdni topshirganingizda BeePost xodimi qabul qiladi va kassada chiqim paydo bo'ladi. Bekor qilishda pul harakati yo'q. Kassa yozuvi holat bilan **bir vaqtda** paydo bo'ladi. Rollback naqd topshirilgandan keyin ham ishlaydi — balans manfiy bo'lishi mumkin. Yo'nalish — `type` (income/expense), `amount` doim musbat.

code.description: Mashina o‘qiydigan kod (bo‘lsa): CARRIER_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED (400), CARRIER_COURIER_INACTIVE (403), CARRIER_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_STALE (409 — yangi kalit), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409 — ayni kalit bilan kutib), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH (422), CARRIER_KEY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE / CARRIER_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (503 — ayni kalit bilan). Qarorni matnga emas, statusCode + code ga qarab qiling.

order_item_id.description: Buyurtma qatori id (scan javobidagi items[].id, UUID). Tavsiya etiladi.

product_id.description: Katalog mahsuloti id (UUID) — order_item_id berilmasa majburiy.

quantity.description: SOTILGAN dona soni (0 — bu qatordan hech narsa sotilmadi).

status.description: `sold` — to‘liq sotildi; `partly_sold` — qisman (items + total_price majburiy); `cancelled` — bekor (reason majburiy); `rollback` — xato belgilangan sotuv/bekorni qaytarish.

reason.description: `cancelled` uchun majburiy. `OTHER` bo‘lsa comment ham majburiy.

total_price.description: `partly_sold` uchun majburiy: mijoz OLGAN tovarlarning to‘liq qiymati (so‘m, butun son). Buyurtma summasidan oshmaydi. BeePost’da oldindan onlayn to‘lov yo‘q (paid_online_amount = 0), ya’ni siz yig‘adigan naqd = total_price.

items.description: `partly_sold` uchun majburiy: buyurtmaning HAR BIR qatori va undan sotilgan dona soni.

old_item_collected.description: Almashtirish buyurtmasi: eski mahsulot mijozdan olindi. `order.replacement.old_item_required: true` bo‘lsa sotishda majburiy true.

soato_code.description: Rasmiy SOATO kodi (viloyat — 4 xona, tuman — 7 xona). null — bu hudud uchun kod BeePost’da yo‘q (id dan foydalaning).

old_item_required.description: true — sotishda old_item_collected: true SHART (eski mahsulotni oling)

parent_order_id.description: Qisman sotuvdan ajralgan sotilmagan qism bo‘lsa — asl buyurtma

cod_amount.description: Mijozdan NAQD olinadigan summa = total_price − paid_online_amount

replacement.description: Almashtirish buyurtmasi bo‘lsa — eski mahsulot mijozdan olinishi kerak; aks holda null

received.description: true — posilka shu skanda sizga qabul qilindi (waiting)

order.description: Buyurtma. null (refreshed: false) — posilka QABUL QILINDI, lekin ma’lumotni hozir o‘qib bo‘lmadi: keyinroq qayta skanerlang (received: false bilan keladi — bu normal).
Yangilangan buyurtma. null — holat QABUL QILINDI, lekin yangilangan buyurtmani hozir o‘qib bo‘lmadi (refreshed: false): GET /carrier/orders bilan keyinroq oling, QAYTA YUBORMANG.

order_ids.description: BeePost’ga qaytariladigan BEKOR QILINGAN posilkalar id’lari (UUID; sizda turgan, holati `cancelled`; qisman sotuvdan ajralgan qism ham). 1–50 ta.

post_id.description: Qaytarish pochtasi id — posilkalarni BeePost’ga shu bilan topshirasiz

source_type.description: Manba: sell — sotuv, correction — tuzatish (rollback), courier_payment — BeePost’ga topshirilgan naqd, extra_cost, courier_penalty — kechikish shtrafi/bonusi. Ro‘yxat OCHIQ — yangi qiymat paydo bo‘lishi mumkin.

amount.description: Doim musbat; yo‘nalish `type` da. `sell` qatori ham `expense` bo‘lishi mumkin (tarifdan arzon sotuv — BeePost sizga qarzdor).

order_id.description: Buyurtma bilan bog‘liq qatorda — buyurtma id

balance.description: Joriy balans — BeePost’ga topshirilishi kerak bo‘lgan summa
